questions.prompt: A reply asks for three tool calls, and none carries a sequential field. In what order do the results reach the model?
options: The order in which the calls happen to finish
The order the model asked for them
The order of the tool list in the system prompt
Any order, because pi sorts results by size
questions.explanation: pi always sends results back in the order the model asked, even when a later call finishes first.

questions.prompt: Four calls share one reply. One of them is marked sequential. What does pi do?
options: It runs the three plain calls together, then the sequential one
It runs all four at the same time and repeats the sequential one
It runs all four one by one, in the order the model asked
It refuses the batch and asks the model to send one call at a time
questions.explanation: One sequential call is enough. The whole batch then runs one by one, so the change cannot overlap with another call.

questions.prompt: One call in a parallel batch throws an error. What happens next?
options: The error becomes a result, the other results still arrive, and the turn continues
The turn ends at once and the session closes
pi runs the whole batch again from the start
The error is dropped and the model never learns of it
questions.explanation: A tool that throws gives back an error result, so the model can read it and decide what to do. The other results in the batch still arrive.
